query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_manifest ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_pk PRIMARY KEY(digest), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_uq_digest_kind UNIQUE(digest, kind), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_chk_digest CHECK(digest ~ '^[a-z0-9]+([+._-][a-z0-9]+)*:[a-f0-9]+$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_chk_size_non_negative CHECK(size >= 0);
